title: Philippine traffic sign detection
methods: YOLO-format bounding boxes mapped to five classes; training balanced to 605 images (121 per class).
YOLOv8n fine-tuned for 80 epochs at 640-pixel input size; fixed-threshold evaluation uses confidence 0.70 and NMS IoU 0.70.
Rule-based displayed suggestions accompany detected signs; no physical robot control.
summary: YOLOv8n detection of five Philippine traffic-sign classes, with validation and external-dataset evaluation.
results: Notebook saved validation: 386 images, precision/recall/F1 0.997409 at confidence 0.70; mAP50 0.995; mAP50-95 0.854614.
Notebook saved external: 265 images, precision 0.865591, recall 0.607547, F1 0.713969; mAP50 0.731875; mAP50-95 0.52286.
limitations: Additional modules, evaluation files and trained checkpoint referenced by the notebook are not included; the standalone webcam application is unavailable from the published files alone.
External-test recall is 0.6075, substantially below validation recall; results cover only five classes.
attribution: Robopuff Girls: Agnote, Rovilyn Doroin, Ivy; Moico, Mary Joyce; Olivares, Tischia Ann (repository owner); Quite, Rona Mae; Tercero, Michelle. Names follow the published README.
concerns: Roboflow and NSIT source licenses/citation unresolved; Ultralytics/model terms need review.
evidence: Historical saved artifacts and source inspection; not independently rerun.
datasetNote: Roboflow training/validation images and a separate Road Signs test dataset. Exact source versions and links are not verified; dataset files are not redistributed.

title: Fish classification and image resolution experiment
methods: Ground-truth masks excluded; inputs resized to 32×32, 64×64 and 128×128.
Flatten → Dense(256) → Dense(128) → softmax; 15 epochs for resolution comparisons.
Saved split counts: 7,200 training, 904 validation and 896 test images.
summary: Nine-class fish classification comparing three image resolutions using a dense neural network, rather than a CNN.
results: Separate evaluation of the selected 32×32 model: accuracy 0.9375; distinct from its comparison-loop score.
limitations: Confirm held-out split, near-duplicate leakage and correct correspondence between displayed metrics and resolution runs. Dataset downloaded externally; not bundled.

Validation dataset is subdivided using take/skip without explicit shuffle=False in directory loading; verify stable disjoint membership across iterations. Saved classification report formatting also needs cleanup.
attribution: Tischia Ann R. Olivares — Individual Academic Project.
concerns: Kaggle fish dataset licensing and derived image permissions unresolved.
evidence: Historical saved artifacts and source inspection; not independently rerun.

title: Image compression and quality retention study
methods: Five images in each of four categories: graphics, photographs, text-based and high-resolution images.
JPEG/WebP quality 90, 70 and 50; PNG compression level 9.
Encoded size, time, PSNR and SSIM recorded in 140 historical observations.
summary: Comparison of JPEG, WebP and PNG encoding across 20 images using size, encoding time, PSNR and SSIM.
results: For g_1.png, JPEG-90 exceeds the input file size; encoding does not always reduce storage.
limitations: The aggregate-summary code drops PNG rows with empty quality values, though PNG is present in the historical results table.
Encoding times depend on the original execution environment.

evidence: Historical saved artifacts and source inspection; not independently rerun.

title: Coin image preprocessing and edge detection
methods: Grayscale conversion, 5×5 median filtering, 3×3 Gaussian smoothing, sharpening and Sobel X/Y gradients.
Gradient magnitudes combined and THRESH_TOZERO applied at 50 in code; notebook prose instead states 40.
summary: Classical image preprocessing and Sobel gradients for emphasizing coin boundaries; no denomination classification or automatic counting.
results: Historical figures show intermediate filtering and edge-emphasis outputs. No accuracy, segmentation metric or coin-count benchmark was established.
limitations: Single-image demonstration with manually selected parameters.
Threshold discrepancy between code (50) and prose (40) remains unresolved.
attribution: Tischia Ann R. Olivares — Individual Academic Project.
